summary: Adds a second, independent entry point (W1-W5) for launches from The Pitt site. M1-M11 are untouched.

add_nodes.notes: Validates pitt.launch.v1 and builds Investigator cases (Amazon DSP only for now).

add_nodes.notes: POSTs to The Pitt (fixed URL, set per environment by the platform owner). Retries are safe: the site rejects a repeated event_id.

add_nodes.notes: Same Investigator as M5. Error output goes to W4e so a failure is reported.

add_nodes.notes: Final Report items as pitt.result.v1 cases (Slack rendering removed).
